integrity: All theorems rely on explicit polar-area geometry and analytic limits; finite numerical checks are supplementary, not proofs. Historical priority provisional and no independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Regular ideal polygons only, with curvature -1 and hyperbolic-area-uniform interior sampling; fixed-n tail and n-to-infinity limits are not asserted uniformly interchangeable. No extension to arbitrary ideal polygons or finite-sample inference.
title: Radial distance in regular ideal hyperbolic polygons: an exact law and a logarithmic many-side limit
